sources.title: Titan system overview and retirement
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Summit POWER9/V100：六 GPU 的工作分組
related.titleEn: Summit POWER9/V100: assigning work to six GPUs
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付卸載事件圖、版本生命週期與完整時間比較；40/32可重建，等待涵蓋D2H完成，重用版本與CPU參考一致；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver offload events, version lifetimes and complete timings. Reproduce 40/32, wait through D2H and match reused versions to the CPU reference. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 把六GPU編0..5，列每張工作ID與CPU準備者；用箭頭保留每份輸入的所有權；30/35正確，GPU映射唯一，所有工作結果與單工作參考一致。
related.differenceEn: Number GPUs 0..5 and list assigned jobs and preparing CPUs, retaining input ownership. Verify 30/35, unique device mapping and every result against a one-job reference.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 不重疊模型T=H2D+kernel+D2H+launch；比較完整路徑，不能只量GPU核函數；合成傳入12、核計算18、傳出8、啟動2毫秒；資料重用後傳入4，其他不變；CPU基準50；名義式 12+18+8+2 = 40 ms；變更式 4+18+8+2 = 32 ms。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
每GPU分配m個等成本工作、每個t毫秒，節點完成時間由max(m)×t決定；合成36個工作、六GPU、每工作5毫秒；另案42工作，忽略傳輸；名義式 (36/6)*5 = 30 ms；變更式 (42/6)*5 = 35 ms。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Without overlap, T=H2D+kernel+D2H+launch; compare complete paths rather than kernel-only timings. Synthetic H2D = 12, kernel 18, D2H = 8, launch 2 ms; reuse reduces H2D to 4; CPU baseline 50. Nominal 12+18+8+2 = 40 ms; changed 4+18+8+2 = 32 ms. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

With m equal-cost jobs per GPU at t milliseconds each, node completion is max(m)×t. Synthetic 36 jobs, six GPUs, 5 ms/job; compare 42 jobs, excluding transfers. Nominal (36/6)*5 = 30 ms; changed (42/6)*5 = 35 ms. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: POWER SMT：延遲隱藏與資源共享
related.titleEn: POWER SMT: latency hiding and shared resources
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付卸載事件圖、版本生命週期與完整時間比較；40/32可重建，等待涵蓋D2H完成，重用版本與CPU參考一致；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver offload events, version lifetimes and complete timings. Reproduce 40/32, wait through D2H and match reused versions to the CPU reference. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 把槽分成有用、等待、重做三色，記各硬體執行緒擁有者；不要把執行緒數當核心數；.45/.65與槽守恆成立，報告不將利用率直接當應用速度比。
related.differenceEn: Color slots useful, waiting, replay and record thread owners; thread count is not core count. Verify 0.45/0.65 and slot conservation without equating utilization to application speedup.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 不重疊模型T=H2D+kernel+D2H+launch；比較完整路徑，不能只量GPU核函數；合成傳入12、核計算18、傳出8、啟動2毫秒；資料重用後傳入4，其他不變；CPU基準50；名義式 12+18+8+2 = 40 ms；變更式 4+18+8+2 = 32 ms。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
有用利用率U=有用發射槽/可用槽，等待與重做都不計有用；每次觀測1000槽，單執行緒有用450；雙執行緒合計有用650，含重做50槽另列；名義式 450/1000 = 0.45 useful utilization；變更式 650/1000 = 0.65 useful utilization。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Without overlap, T=H2D+kernel+D2H+launch; compare complete paths rather than kernel-only timings. Synthetic H2D = 12, kernel 18, D2H = 8, launch 2 ms; reuse reduces H2D to 4; CPU baseline 50. Nominal 12+18+8+2 = 40 ms; changed 4+18+8+2 = 32 ms. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

Useful utilization U=useful issued slots/available slots; waits and repeated work are excluded. Each observation has 1000 slots; one thread uses 450 usefully, two use 650, with 50 replay slots listed separately. Nominal 450/1000 = 0.45 useful utilization; changed 650/1000 = 0.65 useful utilization. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
